definitions.full: H8513. telaah תְּלָאָה noun feminine weariness, hardship ; — ׳ת Exod 18:8 4 t.; of distress of Israel in Egypt Num 20:14 ; in wilderness Exod 18:8 (both J E); from Assyr., Babylonian, etc. Neh 9:32 ; compare Lam 3:5 (|| ראֹשׁ , gall); Mal 1:13 .
